A461_gate_consequence.reframed_novelty: Existing same-Gold timestamp-only decision flip is a necessary nuisance-axis negative control for policy threshold intervention, not a new A461 strict monotonicity positive. Its relevance is measurement design, not established security-specific mechanism.
A461_gate_consequence.must_have_additional_G0_control: Freeze one original source-native scene and an oracle-invariant timestamp-only SHAM arm, verify token count and candidate order, and compare alongside true B/S threshold crossing using independently checked native Gold; mark CFI/length mismatches invalid for causal specificity.
A461_gate_consequence.higher_bar_mechanism: After strict policy-error positive passes, compare timestamp nuisance versus true threshold intervention with bidirectional pointer Q/K/LoRA and equal-norm controls, independent source group validation; no pre-approval for Hook or training.
